prose: Bloomberg sources say Anthropic and Nscale are close to announcing a second $45 billion compute deal, barely a month after the pair announced their first one, though the sources caution talks are still underway and details could change. If signed, it would extend Anthropic's year-long string of giant compute commitments, struck on the belief the spending will pay off even as some investors warn of too much money chasing too little profit. Both companies are pursuing IPOs: Anthropic is expected to go public this year, while Nscale is reportedly facing investor pushback over its proposed $30 billion valuation.
highlights: Second $45B Anthropic-Nscale compute deal reportedly nearing announcement
First $45B deal between the pair was announced only a month earlier
Sources caution talks are live and details could change
Extends Anthropic's year-long run of giant compute commitments
Investor unease about compute spend versus profit continues to build
Anthropic expected to IPO this year; Nscale's IPO faces pushback on a $30B valuation
